the_exclusion_being_overridden.verbatim: Production, paid/model budget, Gold, A03-A11 formal business measurement, new root or identity, cap extension, automatic retry, refund.
the_exclusion_being_overridden.note: The governing document is not modified, withdrawn or reinterpreted. It still says what it says.

why_the_extension_is_needed.summary: The forward cap is exactly exhausted, and the root6 window migration cannot avoid one more forward.
why_the_extension_is_needed.mechanism: context.mjs counts forwards only over execution events after the frozen 44-event baseline, i.e. sequence >= 45. qualificationLimits.forwards is 15. context.mjs:188 requires forwards.length < 15 for NEXT_FORWARD, so the twentieth forward is refused with ALLOCATION_OR_FORWARD_LIMIT_REACHED.
why_the_extension_is_needed.why_a_twentieth_forward_is_unavoidable: root6 produces a new controller_sha256 and new qualification and runtime-acceptance digests. The execution binding must be forwarded to them, and a binding forward is what appends EXECUTION_BINDING_FORWARD_ACCEPTED.
why_the_extension_is_needed.failure_mode_if_applied_without_raising_: Every previous forward was applied by raw SQL rather than through NEXT_FORWARD. Doing that again takes forwards.length to 16 and fails context.mjs:176 on EVERY operation, including RESULT_RECONCILIATION, which would strand the single remaining reserved budget with no way to close the attempt.

live_database_verification.method: Read-only query against clued_control.execution_events ordered by sequence. No write performed.
live_database_verification.reason_for_verifying: The exhaustion finding originally came from an adversarial review that reconstructed the sequences from repository SQL artifacts and explicitly stated it had not queried the database. It was checked against live state before being acted on, because if even one forward had fallen below sequence 45 the cap would not have been exhausted and no override would have been needed.

the_path_not_taken.option: Issue a supplemental applicability document raising the forward cap, Owner-approved and independently reviewed, rather than overriding the exclusion.
the_path_not_taken.precedent: That is exactly how the governing document itself came to exist. Its delegation_effect reads: 'Supplement the consumed historical one-GA numerical limit solely with this exact newly approved maximum-three serial series.' A consumed numerical limit was previously extended by issuing a new approved applicability, not by overriding an exclusion.
the_path_not_taken.why_not_taken: context.mjs:164 requires appendix.independent_reviewer === '/root/project_list_auth_fix'. That identity is a task/session working directory that no longer exists, and the original bootstrap authority forbids the implementing side from replacing the assigned reviewer. A supplemental applicability therefore cannot be issued until the Owner decides the reviewer succession (see IndependentReviewerSuccessionProposal.md, whose SUCCESSOR_IDENTITY is still unfilled).
the_path_not_taken.owner_rationale_recorded: The Owner elected the override on the basis that this is a non-production ISOLATED_TEST qualification run already in remediation for an expired window, and that standing up a full replacement review identity is disproportionate to a test qualification. That is a judgement, not a finding.
the_path_not_taken.consequence_to_state_plainly: This run's compliance narrative now contains a known gap: a declared cap was extended by Owner fiat against an explicit exclusion, without independent review. Any downstream consumer treating this run as a formal credential must weigh that.
